# Saudi Drone Champions League by DCL and Tuwaiq
DCL and Tuwaiq Academy proudly present the **Saudi Drone Champions League (Saudi DCL)** — the first national drone racing competition in Saudi Arabia. University students across the Kingdom compete in DCL’s mixed-reality format, from virtual qualifying rounds to a live final at **LEAP 2026 on August 31 in Riyadh**.
[ Find out more ](https://dronechampionsleague.com/saudi-drone-champions-league/)

### ABOUT US
### About the DCL - Drone Champions League
The Drone Champions League (DCL) is the world’s leading mixed-reality drone racing league, uniting top pilots and stunning real-world locations in an immersive racing experience.
With **Digital Twin technology** , we merge the virtual and real worlds, pushing the boundaries of drone sports. Our simulation game, **DCL – The Game** , brings the thrill of drone racing to everyone on PC, PlayStation, and Xbox.
Beyond racing, we drive innovation in AI, robotics, and autonomous flight, collaborating with top universities and partners. Through our **STEM programs** , we inspire and train the next generation in drone technology, empowering future leaders in emerging fields.
[ Who we are ](https://dronechampionsleague.com/about-us/)

### GAMING
### Experience the Thrill of Drone Racing with DCL – The Game!
Experience the thrill of real drone racing in _DCL – The Game_! Fly through **30+ spectacular tracks** , including legendary real-world locations like the snow halfpipes of LAAX and the castle ruins of Reutte.
With **four flight modes** , from beginner-friendly Arcade to pro-level Acro, there’s a challenge for every pilot. Compete online against racers worldwide and take your drone skills to the next level!
[ Get the game ](https://dronechampionsleague.com/game/)
